messages:
jordan_acme: Hey team — started getting 401 invalid_api_key for the hosted /v1/chat/completions endpoint. This key worked yesterday. No code changes on our side. Can someone help?

maria_support: Sorry you're hitting this, Jordan. Can you paste the exact curl you used (with the key redacted) and the full error body? Also which org/account is the key under?

jordan_acme: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'

  Error body: {"error":{"type":"invalid_api_key","message":"invalid_api_key"}}

maria_support: Thanks. One quick question: did anyone in your org change security settings (IP allowlist, mTLS, token bindings) recently?

jordan_acme: Oh — yes. Our security admin enabled "Require mTLS for API keys" this morning (via org settings) to harden prod traffic. We thought it would only affect new keys.

akshay_infra: Tagging in infra to confirm: when mTLS requirement is turned on, the gateway enforces client cert presence for requests using keys that are bound to that policy. If a cert is missing the gateway returns 401 invalid_api_key (we intentionally avoid revealing policy details).

sam_engineer: Reproduced quickly in a sandbox: call without client cert => 401 invalid_api_key. Call with cert (server-side TLS client cert) => 200. Logs show auth failure subtype: auth_policy_mismatch (key requires_client_cert=true).

maria_support: Can you confirm whether you updated the existing key to be mTLS-bound or created a new bound key?

jordan_acme: We flipped the org setting, didn't touch keys. We expected the gateway to accept connections without certs and only restrict new keys. Looks like the policy applies to all hosted API keys immediately.

akshay_infra: Correct — org-level "require mTLS" flips enforcement across the account. There is a migration path but it needs explicit per-key binding or a grace window (we're planning a UI). For now either: 1) provide client certs from your client and call with --cert/--key, or 2) toggle the org setting off while you roll out certs.

sam_engineer: Repro steps we used:
```
# without cert -> 401
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}]}'

# with cert -> 200
curl -v --cert client.crt --key client.key -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}]}'
```

maria_support: Jordan — if you can provide whether you want to (A) add client certs to your clients (we can help generate a test cert) or (B) temporarily disable the org mTLS requirement while you rollout, we can get you unblocked quickly.

jordan_acme: We need a short-term unblock. Can you toggle it off? Our security team will roll certs later today.

amy_deploy_bot: [deploy-bot] org-policy-change: toggle_mtls_requirement requested by maria_support for org acme-corp — pending approval.

maria_support: I've requested the toggle. If infra approves we'll flip it and let you know. Meanwhile Sam, can you summarize the log entry so we can forward to the customer?

sam_engineer: Log snippet: 
```
level=warn component=auth gateway_id=g-xyz reason=auth_policy_mismatch key_id=key_XXX requires_client_cert=true client_cert_present=false action=deny response=401 invalid_api_key
```

maria_support: Jordan — infra approved and I flipped the policy off for acme-corp. Can you retry your original curl (no cert)?

jordan_acme: Retry now — 200 OK. Thanks! :tada:

maria_support: Great — leaving notes so you can re-enable with a rollout plan: 1) generate client certs or integrate your service with your org's cert issuance (we can provide CSR templates). 2) bind certs to the API key(s) or create new mTLS-bound keys. 3) enable org-level mTLS requirement and validate traffic. Ping us if you want help with steps 1–2.

akshay_infra: Follow-up action: we should add a UI warning and optional grace period when enabling org-level mTLS — filing infra/ops ticket.

jordan_acme: Appreciate the quick help. Will coordinate cert rollout and re-enable mTLS after tests.

maria_support: Thanks all. Closing this thread once Jordan confirms re-enable goes smooth. :white_check_mark:
